A Mid Terrace Building Arranged to Provide a Ground Floor Retail Unit Let to Betfred Producing £15,000 Per Annum and Two Flats On the First and Second Floors (Both Sold off on Long Leases)
To be offered on 7th October 2026

Description

The property comprises a mid terrace building arranged to provide a ground floor retail unit and two flats on the first and second floors.

Tenure

Freehold

Location

The property is situated on a mixed use road close to local shops and amenities. Nearby multiples include Aldi and Pizza Hut. The open spaces of Greville Smyth Park are within easy reach. Transport links are provided by Bedminster rail station.

Accommodation

Ground Floor
Retail Unit
G.I.A approximately 946 sq ft

First and Second Floors
Two Flats (Not Inspected)

Tenancy

The property is subject to 15 year lease to Done Brothers (Cash Betting) Limited t/a Betfred commencing 29th September 2004 at a rent of £15,000 per annum.

We are advised by the Vendor that the property has an ERV of £20,000 per annum

Note

The first floor flat is sold off on a 189 year lease from January 1st 2006 thus approximately 171 years remaining.

The second floor flat is sold off on a 99 year lease from 1st January 2006 thus approximately 79 years remaining.
